model_incomplete: The “{name}” model is not complete on this machine.
download_mismatch: {file}: the file received is not the one expected (size or checksum).
transfer_cut: transfer interrupted by the other machine
no_safe_port: No safe port is free for sd-server on this machine: other programs are using ports {ports}, which browsers cannot reach. Close them, then try again.
port_taken: Another program is listening on the sd-server port ({port}): launch cancelled.
engine_missing: stable-diffusion.cpp is not installed on this machine (setting “stable-diffusion.cpp folder”).
gone_before_image: sd-server stopped, or another program is listening on its port: image not requested.
gone_during_image: sd-server stopped, or another program is listening on its port: image dropped, whatever answers there is not trusted.
image_too_slow: Image still not computed after {hours} hours.
gone_before_video: sd-server stopped, or another program is listening on its port: video not requested.
gone_during_video: sd-server stopped, or another program is listening on its port: video dropped, whatever answers there is not trusted.
video_too_slow: Video still not computed after {hours} hours.
no_webm: sd-server did not return a WebM video.
copy_no_space: The file “{file}” ({size}) can be modified by other accounts on this PC: it must be copied before being loaded, and there is not enough space. Free up space on the AIODOS disk, then try again.
copy_failed: The file “{file}” ({size}) can be modified by other accounts on this PC: it must be copied before being loaded, and the copy failed. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, delete this file from the image models folder, then download the model again (Images view).
file_changed: The file “{file}” has changed since it was verified: other accounts on this PC can modify it. Download it again (Images view).
file_held_open: The file “{file}” can be modified by other accounts on this PC, and another program is keeping it open: it could not be replaced by its verified copy. Close that program and try again; if it keeps happening, delete this file from the image models folder, then download the model again (Images view).
copy_mine_only: Models are only copied between my machines.
file_unavailable: Model file not available on this machine.
not_mine: This machine is not one of mine.
nobody_can_compute: Neither this machine nor my online machines can compute this model: download it first.
prompt_too_long: Description too long ({max} characters at most).
bad_settings: Invalid size, number, duration, steps or seed.
bad_sides: Sides must be multiples of {multiple}, from {low} to {high} pixels.
video_too_big: Video too large for this model.
image_too_big: Image too large for this model.
bad_frames: Duration: from {base} to {max} frames, as {step} × k + {base}.
video_count: From 1 to {max} videos at a time.
image_count: From 1 to {max} images at a time.
video_from_image: A video cannot start from an image.
start_format: Starting image in a format this model does not accept.
wrong_size: image of a different size than requested
